title: Outdoor Night Party Group, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white outdoor snapshot from around 1950 featuring a lively group of young adults gathered at night. The individuals are dressed in mid-century attire, including suits, wide ties, dresses, and a floral corsage, indicating a special occasion such as a prom, evening party, or family celebration. A illuminated white picket fence frames the scene against the dark night background.
